Configure nested Tesseract and PaddleOCR settings in a multi-backend pipeline

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var inputJson = "{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"text/plain\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/text/report.txt\"}";
        var input = JsonUtil.fromJson(inputJson, ExtractInput.class);
        var configJson = "{\"ocr\":{\"enabled\":false,\"pipeline\":{\"quality_thresholds\":{},\"stages\":[{\"backend\":\"tesseract\",\"priority\":100,\"tesseract_config\":{\"enable_table_detection\":false,\"psm\":6}},{\"backend\":\"paddleocr\",\"paddle_ocr_settings\":{\"enable_table_detection\":true,\"model_tier\":\"server\",\"use_angle_cls\":true},\"priority\":90}]}}}";
        var config = JsonUtil.fromJson(configJson, ExtractionConfig.class);
        var result = Xberg.extract(input, config);
        System.out.println(result.results().get(0).mimeType());
        System.out.println(result.results().get(0).content());
    }
}
```
